caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned against a plain background, with the main image centered inside a rectangular border. The chair has a light brown color and features a rounded seat with a woven cane pattern, four slender legs with subtle grooved detailing, and three horizontal supports—two on either side and one in front connecting the legs for stability. The chair back includes an X-shaped cross brace and a slightly curved top rail. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, schematic line sketch of the chair with labeled dimensions: 15" width for the backrest, 32" total height, 17" seat height, and 16" seat width. The large main image is signed at the bottom right with the names “Vincent P. Wood 1561 Del” and “Gordon Saltar” handwritten in red and gray ink respectively. The paper background is off-white.
title: Rush Bottom Chair
